process_and_resource_review.EOF_order: Supervisor alone retains command-pipe writer; producer closes its inherited writer before exec. Supervisor waits for READY, verifies midpoint/root/lock/request/source/known result and pre-close inventory, then closes writer without sending bytes. Worker awaits EOF, records unknown and performs same-instance replay test. Supervisor reaps producer before final fault/inventory verification.
process_and_resource_review.cost_scope: Subtree receipt includes supervisor plus producer once; worker CPU partitions it rather than adding a second charge. Outer measured prefix is extra and final tail unknown. Reviewer/preparation and earlier histories are extra costs. Per-process caps and posthoc terminal tests do not constitute a strict aggregate CPU/RSS/disk quota or universal cleanup guarantee.

existing_shared_lock.mode: supervisor opens existing resolved caller path rb and flock EX|NB; no create/fallback for benchmark lock

process_and_resource_review.fixture_pipe: Separate private fixture pipe is written by the same worker before await_cancel. This tests normal public receipt construction, not external cancellation causality.
process_and_resource_review.inheritance: run_once sets hard and soft caps before spawning; owned_process child inherits without raising. Single CPU affinity and BLAS/OMP/MKL/NUMEXPR thread counts 1 are set before exec. Producer reports exact inherited caps; supervisor checks them.
process_and_resource_review.lock_scope: The unchanged public local-writer wrapper separately creates/owns its per-root .hepta-writer.lock. That is the existing cooperative product protocol, not a substitute for the caller-provided benchmark lock or production authority.
process_and_resource_review.owned_process_safety: Exact previously reviewed owned_process registers its ownership object before fork and stores child PID before unmasking SIGALRM; uses WNOHANG wait4 and marks reap before optional log allocations. Cleanup targets registered unreaped children only. No additional threads/processes or hidden retries.
